# Kolase Arsip — Style Prompt

> An animated-documentary collage on warm newsprint. The frame is a sheet of slightly aged paper with a faint 64 px construction grid and a whisper of moving grain; onto it go archive cutouts (engravings and halftone photos) scissored out and glued down with a thick orange or blue sticker outline. High-contrast serif type does the talking, light 300 for the sentence and black italic 900 for the stressed word, with wide-tracked uppercase labels receding into the page and a red handwritten margin note now and then. Each beat owns exactly one bright blue shape, a circle or a marker box, that the eye locks onto. Motion is choppy and low-shutter, as if shot on twos: things pop with an overshoot and stutter in steps, the camera pushes slowly and racks focus. Full-paper takeovers (tier 1: section, stat, overview) alternate with the speaker's own footage carrying small pasted cards beside them (tier 2: lower third, circled label).

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **Paper first.** Every takeover is warm newsprint (`--latar`) with a faint grid, vignette and grain; nothing looks digital-clean.
2. **Cutouts, not boxes.** Pictures are scissored scraps: halftone fill, engraved ink lines, a 10 px sticker outline, a flat offset shadow, tilted 1.5–3°.
3. **One blue magnet per beat.** One circle or one marker box in `--utama`; never two blue focal shapes fighting.
4. **Serif statement, sans metadata, pen for asides.** The headline is always the serif; labels are uppercase sans; the handwriting is small and rare.
5. **Hand-pasted, never level.** Boxes skew −1.4°, scraps rotate, layouts sit off-grid and left-weighted.
6. **The speaker stays visible on tier-2 beats.** Cards go beside them, never over the face.

Not a slick corporate explainer (no glows, no soft drop shadows, no gradients as decoration). Not smooth motion graphics (no long symmetric eases, no slow fades). Not a news package (no tickers, no anchors). Not a slide deck (no centred title-and-bullets, no sans headlines).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Paper**: `--latar` flat, a 1 px grid every 64 px at 7 % ink, a radial vignette to 16 % ink at the corners, an SVG fractal-noise grain tile (180 px, multiply, 40 %) drawn once on a layer above everything and stepped, never redrawn.
- **Archive cutouts**: `--latar-2` with halftone dots (ink, 1.1 px dots on a 7 px grid) under engraved line art (3 px ink strokes, rounded caps) of the subject; `outline: 10px solid` in `--aksen` (or `--utama` for the alternate card), an 18 × 22 px flat offset shadow at 12 % ink, rotation ±1.2–2.4°. A small blue tag in a corner names the archive.
- **Marker boxes**: flat `--utama` (or ink for the second word) skewed −1.4°, with an 8 px flat offset shadow; words in Fraunces 900 sit on them.
- **Circles**: flat `--utama` discs (300–700 px) behind a stat or a stressed word; a red disc for a stamp ("SEJAK 1987").
- **Handwritten annotation**: hand-drawn ink arrows (4 px, round caps) and an elliptical blue loop around a term; Caveat notes in the fixed editorial red.
- **The speaker's footage** (`<video src="assets/media/upl_….mp4" muted>` from `list_media`) is full bleed under tier-2 cards. For the closing cutout, use `make_cutout` on a 2–6 s range and place `assets/media/cut_….webm` (timing per the cutout rule: `data-start = S + max(0, from − M)`, `data-media-start = max(0, M − from)`), inside an SVG or wrapper that draws the same silhouette 36 px thicker in `--aksen` behind it as the sticker edge. Reframe a landscape clip for 9:16 (craft `reframe.md`): the face sits in the upper middle third. The example paints a stand-in person (room, bokeh, shoulders, head, hair, face) once in SVG and only moves it: head bob, blinks, mouth on speech beats.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the newsprint, `--latar-2` the kraft fill of cutouts.
- `--utama` is the signature blue: the one circle or marker box per beat, the label tags, the moving underline marker. Text on it is `--teks-di-utama`.
- `--aksen` is the cutout orange: sticker outlines (and the speaker cutout's edge). Never a text colour on paper; use `--aksen-di-latar` for that.
- `--teks` is the warm print ink: headlines, engravings, halftone dots, arrows, the second marker box (with `--latar` text on it). `--teks-redup` carries source lines and fine print.
- Fixed in every brand: `--merah`, the editorial red of the kicker rule, the stamp, the lower-third rule and the margin notes. Footage stand-in tokens `--f-*` stay natural (real footage is never recoloured).
- A dark brand turns the sheet into dark paper with light ink and light halftone dots; that is correct, the collage logic holds.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` is Fraunces (Google Fonts, 300 / 900 / 900 italic), tracking −0.03em, line-height 0.96: section headline 138–150 px (stacked marker words 150 px, 128 px in 9:16), stat 260–290 px, card title 104 px, sentence under a stat 56–60 px light with the stressed words in black italic, lower-third name 72–76 px 900, label term 64 px 900. Fallback families: Libre Baskerville, Playfair Display 700.
- `--font-isi` is Archivo 700 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.16em: kickers 24 px (with a 64 × 3 px red rule before them), sources 18 px, tags 18 px, the contact bar 28–30 px. A brand's sans goes here; keep it uppercase and tracked.
- Caveat 700 (fixed) for margin notes only, 46–64 px, rotated −6° to 4°, at most one per beat.
- Keep marker words to one to three per box; a box line never wraps.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Stop-motion cadence**: positional moves and reveals use `steps(6)` over 0.3 s (counters `steps(8)` over 0.6 s; arrow and loop draw-ons `steps(8)` over 0.36–0.4 s). Grain background position steps(4) every 0.5 s, yoyo, for the whole film.
- **Pops**: cutouts and circles `back.out(2.2)` over 0.42 s from scale 0 (stamps and notes also spin in 20–40°); a cutout slides in 80 px with a 10° turn, `back.out(1.8)` over 0.5 s.
- **Marker reveal**: the box wipes on with `scaleX` 0 → 1 from its left edge in 0.3 s `steps(6)`, its word steps in 0.1 s later rising 20 px.
- **Stagger**: 0.08–0.14 s between sub-elements, 0.32 s between stacked marker words, 0.6 s between overview cards. The first thing in is the most important.
- **Ambient**: every takeover pushes 1.00 → 1.06 with a −14 px drift, linear, over the whole beat; footage pushes 1.00 → 1.04.
- **Rack focus**: when the stat lands, the neighbouring cutout cross-fades to a pre-blurred copy (static `blur(7px)`, opacity 0 → 0.65 while the sharp copy drops to 0.35) in 0.3 s `steps(3)`; never tween the blur.
- **Exits**: hard cuts or a stepped slide; never a slow fade. Tier 1 holds 3–8 s with a breathing hold; tier 2 cards stay 2–6 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Slow push 1.00 → 1.06, −14 px drift, linear, whole beat | we are inside the story, keep reading | every takeover |
| Rack focus to the subject (blurred copy cross-fade) | look here, not there | a stat beside a picture, a quote beside its source |
| Stepped slide-in of a cutout (80 px, 10°) | evidence pasted onto the page | archive photos, products, documents |
| Hard cut paper ↔ footage | leaving the story for the witness and back | every tier-1/tier-2 change |
| Footage push 1.00 → 1.04 | the speaker is live, not a still | talking-head beats |
| Marker jump in steps | the next item in a sequence | timelines, steps, rankings |

## 7. Native moves

- **Stacked marker headline.** Two or three words, each on its own skewed box (blue, ink, blue), wiping on 0.32 s apart beside an archive cutout and a red stamp. *Fits content like:* "Roti / subuh / selalu habis"; a creator's "Video / pertama / gagal total"; a teacher's "Pecahan / itu / gampang"; a story's "Rumah / di ujung / gang".
- **Circled term beside the speaker.** A paper chip with a Fraunces 900 term, a blue loop drawn round it in steps, a definition chip below and a red Caveat aside. *Fits content like:* "habis jam 07.00"; "hook 3 detik"; "fotosintesis"; "utang piutang".
- **Stat in the blue circle.** The number counts up in steps inside a big blue disc, a light sentence with a black-italic stress under it, a source line; the photo next to it racks out of focus. *Fits content like:* "1.200 roti setiap pagi"; "48 % penonton berhenti di detik ketiga"; "3 dari 5 siswa"; "17 tahun menunggu".
- **Dated filmstrip.** Three cutout cards with times or years under them, stepping in, a blue underline marker jumping from date to date, ink arrows between. *Fits content like:* a morning in a kitchen; the history of a shop; a creator's first three uploads; a war in three dates.
- **Speaker as sticker.** The presenter cut out with a thick orange edge, pasted beside a closing line with one blue disc behind the stressed word and the contact on an ink bar. *Fits content like:* a pre-order call; "follow untuk bagian 2"; a class invitation; the narrator signing off a story.
- **Lower third on footage.** A blue tag ("PEMILIK"), the name in paper-white Fraunces 900 outlined in ink, a red rule, a paper role chip. *Fits content like:* a shop owner; a guest expert; a teacher; a character's name card.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Two blue focal shapes in one frame; a second accent goes ink, orange or red.
- Smooth glides and slow fades: if it glides, it is wrong; snap and stutter.
- Soft blurred shadows, glows or decorative gradients; depth comes from scale, overlap and rack focus.
- Sans headlines, or Fraunces at one weight only: the 300/900 contrast is the look.
- Cards over the speaker's face on tier-2 beats; keep them in the free half and the bottom band.
- Animating `filter: blur` (use a pre-blurred copy) or redrawing the grain.
- A light brand whose blue is pale: the ink text on it still reads; never swap to white text on the box.
- Real archive photos without rights, or captions that invent a source.
- Long handwriting: one short note per beat, never body copy.

## Measured from the references

- Card library: tier-1 takeovers 5–8 s, tier-2 overlays 6–14 s; entrance 0.42 s, exit 0.3 s; stagger 0.08–0.14 s.
- Sizes at 1920 × 1080: hero stat 320 px, takeover headline 150 px, section title 92 px, card headline 56 px, body 32 px, label 24 px, fine print 18 px; padding 56 px; radius 2 px.
- Texture: grid 64 px at 7 % ink; halftone 7 px; grain 180 px tile at 40 % multiply; vignette 16 % ink beyond 55 %.
- Cutout: 470 × 560 px, outline 10 px, rotation 2.2°, offset shadow 18 × 22 px at 12 %.

# Archive collage: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3, long 4.

## hook

- en: section takeover: red-ruled kicker, two or three stacked words on blue and ink marker boxes, an orange-outlined cutout, a red stamp
- id: kartu bab penuh: label bergaris merah, dua-tiga kata bertumpuk di kotak biru dan hitam, guntingan arsip bergaris oranye, cap merah

## problem

- en: the speaker's footage; beside them a term chip circled in blue, its definition under it, a red handwritten margin note
- id: rekaman pembicara; di sampingnya istilah dilingkari biru, definisinya di bawah, catatan pinggir merah tulisan tangan

## fact

- en: beside the speaker: a cutout pinned on paper, a hand-drawn arrow to a blue-tagged label and a small source line
- id: di samping pembicara: guntingan ditempel, panah tangan ke label bertanda biru, dan baris sumber kecil

## step

- en: overview takeover: three dated cutout cards step in 0.6 s apart, a blue marker jumps under each time, ink arrows between
- id: kartu ikhtisar: tiga guntingan bertanggal masuk bergantian, penanda biru melompat ke tiap jam, panah tinta di antaranya

## compare

- en: two cutouts side by side, one outlined orange and one blue, a Fraunces verdict word on a blue box between them
- id: dua guntingan berdampingan, satu bergaris oranye satu biru, kata putusan serif di kotak biru di antaranya

## number

- en: stat takeover: the number in black serif on one big blue circle, counted in steps; the cutout racks out of focus
- id: kartu angka: angka serif hitam di lingkaran biru besar, dihitung tersendat; guntingan di sampingnya jadi kabur

## proof

- en: the document as a tilted archive cutout, its key line boxed in blue, a red margin note and the source label
- id: dokumen sebagai guntingan arsip miring, kalimat pentingnya dikotak biru, catatan merah di pinggir, label sumber

## offer

- en: the product as a sticker-outlined cutout, its name in Fraunces 900, the price on a blue marker box that wipes in
- id: produk sebagai guntingan bergaris stiker, namanya serif tebal, harga di kotak penanda biru yang menyapu masuk

## cta

- en: the speaker as a cutout with an orange sticker edge; the line with one blue circle behind a word, contact on an ink bar, held 2 s
- id: pembicara jadi guntingan bertepi oranye; kalimat dengan satu lingkaran biru di balik kata, kontak di pita hitam, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: back to the opening cutout, a Fraunces line with its italic black word on a blue box, a red margin note, held 2 s
- id: kembali ke guntingan pembuka, kalimat serif dengan kata miring tebal di kotak biru, catatan merah, diam 2 dtk
